articles.title: Governance on autopilot, minus the turbulence
articles.summary: Google Cloud automates data governance with lineage, reducing daily tax and compliance failures.
articles.detail: Google Cloud introduces automated data governance to reduce the cost of manual processes, ensuring compliance and reducing errors. This innovation enables organizations to focus on high-value tasks rather than mundane data management.

articles.title: Building cost-effective, high-throughput gen AI workflows in Google Dataflow
articles.summary: Google Cloud enables real-time streaming pipelines with generative AI agents for adaptive execution.
articles.detail: Google Cloud introduces a new approach to real-time data processing by integrating generative AI agents into streaming pipelines. This innovation allows for adaptive execution, moving beyond static logic and fixed processing paths.

articles.title: How Box is unlocking multimodal enterprise agents with Gemini Embeddings 2
articles.summary: Box leverages Gemini Embeddings 2 to enable multimodal enterprise AI agents for search and retrieval.
articles.detail: Box partners with Google Cloud to unlock the potential of multimodal AI agents, enabling augmented generation capabilities and transforming enterprise content management.

articles.title: Staying Ahead of Adversarial AI Through Agentic Source Code Review
articles.summary: Google Cloud introduces structured analysis process to identify and patch vulnerabilities in source code.
articles.detail: Google Cloud addresses the growing threat of adversarial AI by introducing a systematic approach to identifying and mitigating vulnerabilities in source code, ensuring the security of cloud-based applications.

articles.title: Building operational resilience with agentic AI in financial services
articles.summary: Google Cloud enables financial institutions to build operational resilience with agentic AI.
articles.detail: Google Cloud partners with financial institutions to implement agentic AI, enhancing operational resilience and meeting stringent regulatory requirements. This innovation ensures the security and reliability of critical financial systems.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Managed Instance on Azure App Service
articles.summary: Azure introduces managed instances for web applications, enabling easy migration to cloud.
articles.detail: Microsoft announces the general availability of managed instances on Azure App Service, simplifying the migration of web applications to the cloud and enhancing overall application management.

articles.title: How Cisco and Auvik simplify network modernization for AI
articles.summary: Cisco partners with Auvik to provide IT teams with AI-ready infrastructure insights.
articles.detail: Cisco collaborates with Auvik to offer a comprehensive solution for network modernization, enabling organizations to prepare their infrastructure for AI adoption and ensuring seamless operations.

articles.title: Meet The Data Center Lens video series: Clear answers for modernizing and scaling for AI
articles.summary: Cisco introduces a video series providing guidance on infrastructure modernization and scaling for AI.
articles.detail: Cisco launches The Data Center Lens video series, offering practical advice and insights on modernizing infrastructure to support AI adoption and ensuring seamless operations at scale.

articles.title: [In preview] Public Preview: Ipv6 support in Azure Firewall
articles.summary: Azure announces public preview of IPv6 support in Azure Firewall.
articles.detail: Microsoft introduces a public preview of IPv6 support in Azure Firewall, enabling customers to configure and manage firewall rules for both IPv4 and IPv6 traffic.

articles.title: AI Networking Stocks Are Rallying on Monday. Marvell Up 8%, Credo Up 8%, Ciena Joins the Move
articles.summary: AI networking stocks surge as investors respond to a research note on chip ramp.
articles.detail: A research note on AI chip demand drives up stock prices for companies like Marvell, Credo, and Ciena, highlighting investor optimism in the sector.

articles.title: Nvidia's AI moat is shifting from chips to capital
articles.description: Nvidia expands its AI offerings beyond chipmaking, leveraging its dominance in the sector.
articles.summary: Nvidia diversifies its AI business, moving beyond chip manufacturing and into areas like capital investments, further solidifying its market position.
articles.detail: Nvidia's strategy shift towards capital investments demonstrates its commitment to expanding its AI ecosystem and maintaining a competitive edge.

articles.title: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure VMware Solution License-included service will be retired August 30, 2027
articles.summary: Azure announces the retirement of its license-included Azure VMware Solution service.
articles.detail: Microsoft sets a retirement date for its Azure VMware Solution license-included service, citing changes in VMware licensing policies and encouraging customers to migrate to alternative offerings.
